subject: general
question: According to Article 112 of the Constitution of India, the Union Budget of a year is called ________.
solution:
The correct answer is __**Annual Financial Statement**__.

 [IMAGE: https://cdn.repeatermock.com/tb/36f36cd5ece4186095afcf2ffbfb7b80cc04b6c2e3226e7477a419a9fbc96f85.png] **__Key Points__**

__
 
• In terms of** Article 112 (1**) of the **Constitution of India**, a statement of estimated **receipts and expenditures of the Government of India is presented to the Parliament every year**.
 
• **Article 112(2) **provides that the **estimate of expenditure embodied **in **this annual financial Budget** shall **show separately**.
 
• The **annual Financial Statement **shows the **receipts and payments of the Government **under the **three parts **in which Government accounts are kept: **(i) Consolidated Fund, (ii) Contingency Fund, and (iii) Public Account.**
 
• **Annual reports typically include financial statements**, **such as balance sheets**, **income statements**, and **cash flow statements**. In **addition**, there will **often be graphs or charts included**, **helping break down **the **financials into easily readable information**.

 [IMAGE: https://cdn.repeatermock.com/tb/f13e2ad6582c16aa62a83672e2547ad20a01fddb61962a1acce42eb9a1a99caa.png] **Additional Information__**

 
• The **level of government spending **or the **amount of money the government spends **is **called the Fiscal Budget**.
 
• **Assessment Statement **means **the statement provided **by the **Validation/Verification Body **in accordance with **the VCS Program Rules **in respect of **the Methodology Element**.
 
• **The annual Financial Statement **distinguishes **the expenditure on **the **revenue account **from **the expenditure on other accounts**, as **mandated **in the **Constitution**.
